==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=AspNetCore&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.AspNetCore: writes ASP.NET Core types as readable snapshots instead of as their raw object graphs.
        VerifyAspNetCore.Initialize();

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/AspNetCoreTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=AspNetCore&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

// Verify.AspNetCore: Snapshots ASP.NET Core types: HttpContext, requests, responses, headers, cookies and every ActionResult.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.AspNetCore
// Note: The package targets net10.0 only.
public class AspNetCoreTests
{
    // Verifying the result and the context together shows both what the action returned and
    // what it did to the response: status code, headers and cookies.
    [Fact]
    public Task Controller()
    {
        var context = new ControllerContext
        {
            HttpContext = new DefaultHttpContext()
        };
        var controller = new MyController
        {
            ControllerContext = context
        };

        var result = controller.Method("inputValue");
        return Verify(
            new
            {
                result,
                context
            });
    }

    // ScrubAspTextResponse edits the response body text before it is written, for values that
    // change on every run.
    [Fact]
    public Task ScrubResponse()
    {
        var context = new DefaultHttpContext();
        context.Response.Headers.Append("Set-Cookie", "session=abc123");
        return Verify(context.Response)
            .ScrubAspTextResponse(_ => _.Replace("abc123", "{session}"));
    }
}
